name: Evidence & Investigation
description: The tools and textures of investigation — drawers full of records, open books, and the fragments left when certainty breaks.

assets.alt: Rows of labeled archive drawers in a dimly lit room
assets.caption: Every drawer holds a question someone once thought was answered.

assets.alt: An open book with aged pages
assets.caption: The evidence is always in the footnotes.

assets.alt: A ceramic plate broken into pieces, carefully laid out
assets.caption: Certainty shatters. The pieces remain.
